summary.description: Optional question or summary sentence, shown first (plain text, newlines kept). http(s) addresses in the text become links. Without it the banner's task.why and the facts carry the request.

actor.description: Who acts next. bot (default): the primary Approve & continue, or Approve & post / send when action is set; the quiet alternatives Reject and, when allow_changes is set, Request changes. Each sends with one click; Request changes first asks for the comment. Results approve, reject, request_changes. user: the person does it and reports back. The mark names what they did: Posted when task.kind is post_yourself, Sent when action is send, Done only when there is no specific content or action. Results stay done / skipped. The hint names those choices. Request changes stays available when allow_changes is set. none: info only (Got it, plus one optional collapsed note that is kept as a draft; result acknowledged). The bot never acts on user or none.

action.description: Optional verb. For the bot: post becomes Approve & post, send becomes Approve & send, any other verb (including deploy) becomes Approve & continue. For the user, send becomes Sent.

approve_label.description: Optional label of the approving primary for the bot, e.g. "Approve deploy". Wins over action. Without it the primary is Approve & post, Approve & send, or Approve & continue, from action. There is no plain Approve default.

allow_changes.description: Offer "Request changes" (comment required) as a second quiet alternative for a bot or user action. Ignored for information only.

facts.description: Key facts as label/value pairs under the summary (amount, requester, version, period).

mono.description: Show the value in the monospace font (versions, ids, amounts).

copy.description: Values the person would otherwise retype; each is shown in full next to its button.

text.description: Exact string that lands on the clipboard.

points_title.description: Heading of the points list; default "Details".

points.description: Short bullet points (what changes, why it is needed).

checks.description: Checks with a status dot (tests, policies, prior approvals).

reference.description: A longer value behind a closed disclosure (rollback command, full terms), with a copy button.

text.description: Exact string that lands on the clipboard.

mono.description: Show the text in the monospace font (commands, paths).
